title: Chiang Mai cafés: 15 picks for work, coffee and gardens
desc: Fifteen cafés around Chiang Mai, grouped into laptop-friendly spots, coffee and brunch, and garden hangouts.

items.title: Akha Ama Phrasingh
items.memo: Fast Wi-Fi but no power outlets; try the soda lemon drink.

items.title: General Coffee
items.memo: Free Wi-Fi and plenty of plugs; blueberry cheesecake square.

items.title: Maled Coffee Roasters (โรงคั่วเมล็ด)
items.memo: Roasts in-house; banoffee cake sells out, so go before 1 pm.

items.title: GRAPH Contemporary
items.memo: Lots of plugs and seats in whitewashed brick; square butter cake.

items.title: Beam&Col. coffee bar
items.memo: Coworking in a former ice factory at Weave Artisan Society; carrot cake.

items.title: The Barn Eatery And Design
items.memo: Greenhouse-style spot for working late, busy with students.

items.title: GRAPH quarter
items.memo: Bakery hub for all GRAPH branches; craft-soda coffee with seaweed.

items.title: Ristr8to Original (Nimman)
items.memo: Coconut mocha; small with no A/C, better for coffee than laptops.

items.title: Sensation Coffee Roasters
items.memo: Roasts in-house; cappuccino with chocolate mousse cake.

items.title: The Larder Cafe & Bar
items.memo: Aussie-style brunch, smoked-salmon open sandwich; often a queue.

items.title: The Baristro Asian Style
items.memo: Japanese zen garden setting with a slow matcha bar.

items.title: Cafe Arte
items.memo: Rooms, courtyards and gardens; brownies; closed Thursdays.

items.title: Fernpresso at Lake
items.memo: Big lawn on the CMU campus plus an A/C room with plugs.

items.title: Much Room Cafe
items.memo: Shaded by Lanna trees; chicken tikka masala with naan.

items.title: Fringe.th Cafe and Restaurant
items.memo: Eclectic decor; turns into a bar with live music at night.
